title: Training Casebook: Date to Which Interest Runs at a Whole Life Insurance Loan Offset
content:
Interest extinguished at a loan offset on an Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy runs to the date the offset takes effect, which depends on the occasion shown in the records:

1. **Where a death claim on the policy is on file** — to the insured's date of death recorded on that death claim.
2. **Where no death claim is on file and the policy is premium-paying with a paid-to date later than the date the offset is booked** — to that paid-to date, the date a reduced paid-up or extended term option takes effect. A policy is premium-paying while its status is in force or in the grace period.
3. **Otherwise** — to the date the offset is booked.

## Cases (hypothetical, offset booked on August 12, 2025)

**Case 1.** A death claim is on file with a date of death of July 28, 2025. Interest runs to July 28, 2025.

**Case 2.** No death claim; the policy is in force, paid to October 1, 2025, and the owner is going onto reduced paid-up insurance. Interest runs to October 1, 2025.

**Case 3.** No death claim; the policy is in its grace period with a paid-to date of July 1, 2025, earlier than the booking date. Interest runs to August 12, 2025.

**Case 4.** No death claim; the policy is terminating for loan default and is paid-up, so it is not premium-paying. Interest runs to August 12, 2025.

| Death claim on file | Premium-paying | Paid-to date later than booking | Interest runs to |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Any | Any | Date of death |
| No | Yes | Yes | Paid-to date |
| No | Yes | No | Booking date |
| No | No | Any | Booking date |
